headline: Indian Banks Step Up M&A Financing Following Eased RBI Rules
summary: Indian lenders, including State Bank of India, have financed over a dozen major M&A deals exceeding 10,000 crore after the central bank eased takeover-financing rules.
why: The Reserve Bank of India regulates commercial banking activities. Allowing banks to fund larger portions of corporate acquisitions stimulates domestic merger and acquisition activity.

impacts.name: Indian Banking
impacts.why: Regulatory easing by the RBI allowed domestic banks to deploy capital into lucrative acquisition financing deals.
